title: Aurora Shrine
body:
A hidden location underneath Icelands where the Auroracrest Axe and Auroracrest Pickaxe are obtained. Entering requires either 1 Small Bomb or the Flamethrower to break a weak ice wall at the special cave entrance.

The Quest can only be completed during the Aurora Borealis, without the Aurora both the bridge and pedestal are inactive. If you leave the quest items on the pedestal while it's inactive, the quest will still complete even if you're elsewhere in the server when an Aurora starts
